hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail
# ----- clean dirs (your original had logic + directory-name mixups) ----- mkdir -p beforeRemoval data completed processing find beforeRemoval -type f -delete || true find data -type f -delete || true find completed -type f -delete || true find processing -type f -delete || true
# ----- assume role (use jq instead of grep/cut/sed) ----- assume_role() { local role_arn="$1" local session_name="$2" local duration="${3:-3600}"
aws sts assume-role \ --duration-seconds "$duration" \ --role-arn "$role_arn" \ --role-session-name "$session_name" \ > assume-role-output.json
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID="$(jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId' assume-role-output.json)" AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey' assume-role-output.json)" AWS_SESSION_TOKEN="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken' assume-role-output.json)" }
unset_role() { unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN }
assume_role "arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl" "s3-test" 3600
# ----- pull inputs + metadata ----- aws s3 cp "$managed_inputs" . aws s3 cp --quiet "s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/general/data/metadata_new_search.json" .
# Produce a TSV so bash can read reliably (avoids CSV quoting/comma problems) csvcut -c "Study Abbreviated Name","Study Identifier","Study Type","Data is ready to process","Data Processed" Managed_Inputs.csv \ | csvformat -T \ > inputs.tsv
if [[ ! -f inputs.tsv ]]; then echo "ERROR: inputs.tsv not created" exit 2 fi
# ----- download + split per ready study (parallel) ----- # Skip header row from csvcut output: tail -n +2 inputs.tsv | while IFS=$'\t' read -r abv_name stdy_id stdy_type data_ready data_processed; do # skip blank lines [[ -z "${abv_name:-}" || -z "${stdy_id:-}" ]] && continue
if [[ "${data_ready,,}" == "yes" ]]; then ( src="s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/${abv_name,,}/completed/${stdy_id}/${stdy_id,,}_allConcepts_new_search_with_data_analyzer.csv" dst="beforeRemoval/${stdy_id,,}_allConcepts_new_search_with_data_analyzer.csv" prefix="beforeRemoval/${stdy_id,,}_allConcepts_new_search_with_data_analyzer.part_"
# download if ! aws s3 cp --no-progress --quiet "$src" "$dst"; then echo "No data found for 'ready' study ${abv_name} ${stdy_id} (download failed)" exit 255 fi
# file must exist and be non-empty if [[ ! -s "$dst" ]]; then echo "No data found for 'ready' study ${abv_name} ${stdy_id} (empty file)" rm -f "$dst" exit 255 fi
# split into ~250MB chunks WITHOUT breaking lines # output files: ...part_00.csv, ...part_01.csv, ... split -d -C 250M --additional-suffix=.csv "$dst" "$prefix"
rm -f "$dst" echo "Downloaded and split ${stdy_id}" ) & else echo "${abv_name} marked not ready for processing in managed inputs" fi done
# Extra downloads you had (also parallel) aws s3 cp --no-progress --quiet \ "s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/hrmn/completed/HRMN_allConcepts.csv" \ "beforeRemoval/HRMN_allConcepts.csv" &
aws s3 cp --no-progress --quiet \ "s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/general/completed/GLOBAL_allConcepts_merged.csv" \ "beforeRemoval/GLOBAL_allConcepts.csv" &
wait
# ----- your parallelism sizing + java steps (kept as-is) ----- CORES="$(nproc)" # 16 on r5.4xlarge HEAP_GB=64
CPU_CAP=12 MEM_CAP=$((HEAP_GB / 6))
PARALLEL="$CORES" [ "$PARALLEL" -gt "$CPU_CAP" ] && PARALLEL="$CPU_CAP" [ "$PARALLEL" -gt "$MEM_CAP" ] && PARALLEL="$MEM_CAP" [ "$PARALLEL" -lt 4 ] && PARALLEL=4
echo "Using parallelism=$PARALLEL (cores=$CORES, heap=${HEAP_GB}g)"
java -Xms32g -Xmx${HEAP_GB}g \ -DmaximumPoolSize="$PARALLEL" \ -Djava.util.concurrent.ForkJoinPool.common.parallelism="$PARALLEL" \ -XX:+ExitOnOutOfMemoryError \ -XX:+HeapDumpOnOutOfMemoryError \ -XX:HeapDumpPath=./oom-heapdump.hprof \ -Xlog:gc*,safepoint:file=gc.log:time,level,tags \ -jar jars/RemoveConsentZeroPatients.jar || exit 255
java -Xmx64g -jar jars/DbGapDataMerge.jar || exit 255
# ----- re-assume for upload (you can keep this pattern, but jq makes it reliable) ----- unset_role assume_role "arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl" "s3-test" 3600
echo "copying to s3" aws s3 cp --no-progress \ "completed/allConcepts.csv" \ "s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/general/completed/allConcepts_data_analyzer.csv"
unset_role
